data.narrative: Suspicious activity observed on account ACC-70921 under customer Jennifer Martinez (CUST-88901). Pattern of concurrent incidents (INC-FIN-AP12-V5A and INC-FIN-AP12-V5B) indicates potential coordinated attempt to bypass detection thresholds. Initial transaction analysis showed low-risk profile with minimal rule triggers (FRD-101 only) and no external fraud database matches. Customer profile remains low-risk with verified KYC and no adverse indicators. However, the temporal correlation between two low-severity incidents within 150 seconds raises concern for a pattern-splitting tactic designed to evade accumulation-based detection systems. No suspicious fund flows or network connections identified via graph analysis. Document verification confirmed authenticity of submitted ID. Despite lack of monetary loss or confirmed compromise, behavioral anomaly and attack pattern justify SAR filing for account takeover preparation or reconnaissance. No funds were transferred as part of the suspicious behavior; thus, total amount involved is $0. Account remains under monitoring. No law enforcement contact initiated at this time.
